topic: Low: labels_v has no payload index
detail: SP-025 filters every named space's reads on labels_v (INV-08) as an integer match, but collections index only source_uri, writer, space and the search fields, so Qdrant scans for that condition, and a server with unindexed filtering disabled (strict mode) would refuse every filtered read (it fails closed: sessions read nothing). Proposed: create an integer payload index on labels_v with the others when a collection is made, and add it to existing collections with the reindex or relabel tooling (SP-027).
